name: com.carrentalbrain/car-rental-brain
title: Car Rental Brain
description: Live car-hire prices ranked by true total, plus deposits, debit cards, driver fees at 180+ airports.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: What Car Rental Brain measures, how fresh it is, and which airports/countries are covered. Use first when unsure whether a place is covered.

detail.description: short (default): the answer, with more_detail naming anything left out; full: every field.

tools.name: list_airports
tools.description: Airports we measure, with the typical rental price per day. Filter by country. Use to find an airport id or to list what is covered in a country.

currency.description: Optional: the person's currency, e.g. GBP, USD, or 'pounds'. Every money figure is then converted at the ECB reference rate, with the rate and its date returned. Default: the measured currency (EUR).

detail.description: short (default): the answer, with more_detail naming anything left out; full: every field.

tools.name: airport_costs
tools.description: The true cost of hiring a car at one airport: per-day price for the car alone, with a second driver, with full cover, automatic, no-deposit (from + typical); by pick-up month; second-driver fees; deposits; debit-card acceptance; desk closing times and out-of-hours fees; policies; Brain's pick per car size (the well-rated supplier that is usually cheapest here, measured - say 'usually'). Use when someone asks what car hire really costs at one airport, or about deposits, fees or desk hours there.

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

currency.description: Optional: the person's currency, e.g. GBP, USD, or 'pounds'. Every money figure is then converted at the ECB reference rate, with the rate and its date returned. Default: the measured currency (EUR).

detail.description: short (default): the answer, with more_detail naming anything left out; full: every field.

tools.name: compare_airports
tools.description: Rank airports by real cost (car only / with driver / with cover), typical deposit, debit-card friendliness or late desk hours. Use for 'where in Spain is car hire cheapest in March?' or 'which airport is best for a debit card?'

sort_by.description: What to rank by: price (car only), price_with_driver, price_with_cover, deposit (lowest first), debit (most debit-friendly), late_desk (open latest). Default price.

month.description: Optional pick-up month YYYY-MM (price sort uses that month)

currency.description: Optional: the person's currency, e.g. GBP, USD, or 'pounds'. Every money figure is then converted at the ECB reference rate, with the rate and its date returned. Default: the measured currency (EUR).

tools.name: supplier_terms
tools.description: Per supplier at an airport: typical price per day, second-driver fee, full-cover price, deposit held, whether the desk takes a debit card, and customers' desk review scores. Use when the person is choosing between suppliers at one airport or asks about a named supplier.

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

currency.description: Optional: the person's currency, e.g. GBP, USD, or 'pounds'. Every money figure is then converted at the ECB reference rate, with the rate and its date returned. Default: the measured currency (EUR).

month.description: Optional pick-up month YYYY-MM: each supplier also gets in_month, its prices for that month (season moves a company's price a lot)

detail.description: short (default): the answer, with more_detail naming anything left out; full: every field.

tools.name: recommend_rental
tools.description: ONE call for a car-hire question at one airport: the usual total for the person's dates split into rental, second-driver fee, cover and out-of-hours fee (deposit shown separately as a card hold), the suppliers that usually suit their needs with each requirement marked meets / unverified and its evidence (debit card, deposit limit, automatic, 7 seats, car size, cross-border - checked together, company by company), and the correctly dated search link to book. Measured history, not live offers. Use first when the person gives dates or needs (debit card, deposit limit, second driver, late arrival).

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

age.description: Main driver's age in years (default 35). Under 25 or over 70 often costs more.

residence.description: Two-letter country of residence, e.g. GB

extra_driver.description: True if a second driver will drive - their fee is then in every total.

full_cover.description: True if they want DiscoverCars' Full Coverage priced in.

debit_card.description: True if the driver has no credit card - only cars whose desk takes a debit card for the deposit.

car_type.description: Car size; omit for every size.

seven_seater.description: True if they need 7 or more seats.

cross_border.description: True if they will drive into another country.

dropoff_airport.description: Optional return airport (code or name) when it differs from the pick-up - a one-way hire. One-way fees are not measured: the live search shows them in each total

max_deposit.description: The most the person can have held as a deposit (0 = no deposit). A hard limit, checked supplier by supplier.

tools.name: desks_open
tools.description: Which car-hire desks at an airport are still open when the person lands: each company's own measured closing time, sorted into open / closes within 45 minutes of landing / already closed, the 24-hour desks, the typical late pick-up fee and a search link timed to reach the desk. Use for late or night flights ('we land at 23:40, who is still open?').

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

arrival_time.description: Optional landing time, local, e.g. 23:40. Without it: every company's closing time, latest first.

currency.description: Optional: the person's currency, e.g. GBP, USD, or 'pounds'. Every money figure is then converted at the ECB reference rate, with the rate and its date returned. Default: the measured currency (EUR).

tools.name: search_rentals
tools.description: LIVE offers for exact dates: the top cars ranked by the total actually paid (second-driver fee included when asked), with supplier, deposit, debit-card acceptance, excess, fuel policy, desk hours and rating, plus the link where the person sees the same cars and books.

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

place.description: Any car-hire location if not a measured airport

age.description: Main driver's age in years (default 35). Under 25 or over 70 often costs more.

residence.description: Two-letter country of residence, e.g. GB

extra_driver.description: True if a second driver will drive - their fee is then in every total.

debit_card.description: True if the driver has no credit card - only cars whose desk takes a debit card for the deposit.

car_type.description: Car size; omit for every size.

dropoff_airport.description: Optional return airport or place when it differs from the pick-up - a one-way hire. Each total then includes the one-way fee.

tools.name: track_price_link
tools.description: Price-drop alerts: when the person is not ready to book, or asks to be told if the price falls, offer this. Returns a link that opens live prices for their dates with a 'Track this price' box; they enter and confirm their own email there and get an email if the price drops, a reminder after 2 days and a last call a week before pick-up (up to 4 emails, one-click stop). Never ask for or pass on their email - the link is all they need.

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

place.description: Any city/place if not a measured airport

age.description: Main driver's age in years (default 35). Under 25 or over 70 often costs more.

residence.description: Two-letter country of residence, e.g. GB

extra_driver.description: True if a second driver will drive - their fee is then in every total.

debit_card.description: True if the driver has no credit card - only cars whose desk takes a debit card for the deposit.

car_type.description: Car size; omit for every size.

tools.name: build_search_link
tools.description: A link for the PERSON to open: live prices for their exact dates and needs, ranked by the total they will actually pay, where they can book. Use whenever the person has dates and wants to see or book cars. Works for any place; coverage says whether Car Rental Brain has measured it (not_measured: no figures of ours exist there - say so, quote none).

debit_card.description: True if the driver has no credit card - only cars whose desk takes a debit card for the deposit.
